description: An opaque navy floor-length gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and fine geometric woven borders at the neck, sleeve cuffs, central panels, and hem. A cream underdress panel is visible down the center. Round shoulder brooches and a patterned belt secure the dress. A grey-brown fringed wool wrap drapes along the forearms; a small pendant and brown decorated shoes are visible.
